title: Where the supplied grader gates
description: STORY_GUIDANCE.json lists sh sources/run.sh as the gate for CSV-002, CLI-002 and FRQ-001. run.sh runs all 22 checks and has no selector, so it fails by construction until every story is built. Only the terminal story runs it; the three stories keep their ids and gate on scoped criteria that run the built executable on the checks they own.

options.label: Only the terminal verification story runs run.sh
Run run.sh in the three named stories as well

title: Profile fields are filled incrementally
description: Type, count, extreme and statistic fields are owned by separate stories, and each story's criteria observe its own field through the executable. PRF-001 emits column and rows; the other fields stay empty until their owner story is built. The terminal run.sh gate requires them all.

options.label: Each story fills only its own fields

title: CSV syntax errors map to exit 3
description: The sources do not state the exit status for a record encoding/csv cannot parse, such as a bare quote. It is rejected content that was read, so the narrowest consistent choice is exit 3 rather than 1.

title: Split of exit codes 1 and 2 between stories
description: CSV-004 names both read failures and usage errors. Exit 1 is owned by CSV-004; exit 2 is owned by CLI-001 and CLI-002, so no behavior has two owners. Usage validation runs before the file is opened.

options.label: CSV-004 owns exit 1; CLI-001 and CLI-002 own exit 2

title: Date-shaped column with an impossible date
description: A column whose values all look like YYYY-MM-DD but include an impossible date, such as 2025-02-30, is not date. It falls through the ladder to text, which matches the supplied orders data.
